description: Directory of local help for a welcome desk, library or club: places grouped by kind (food pantries, free meals, medical rides, shelters, utility help), with address, phone, structured open days plus times, and a last-checked date that flags stale hours. Volunteers add and edit places themselves and print a one-page list; a type-ahead search understands 'food tuesday'; a map view shows numbered pins fully offline (optional street map when online; addresses looked up once on save, or tap to place). Backup/restore, spreadsheet export, works offline. Stores only public place details, never visitor information.

config_schema.org: string, name shown at top and on the printout (edited inside the app)
config_schema.deskNote: string, note at the bottom of the printout (edited inside the app)
config_schema.staleDays: number, ask people to call first when last checked longer ago than this (default 90)
config_schema.tiles: boolean, show street map behind pins when online (default true)
config_schema.categories: optional in the data: [{id,label,color,words}] to replace the default kinds of help
